info.title: BLA Logistics API
info.description:
API for the BLA delivery-operations platform. Generated from the route tree (scripts/generate-openapi.ts) — regenerate with `npm run openapi:generate` after adding or changing routes; tests/unit/openapi-spec.test.ts fails on drift.

Authentication is a session cookie issued by the app's own sign-in (Auth.js database sessions — there is no JWT and no API key). Sign in through the BLA login page in this browser first, then use Try it out: requests go to the same origin with your existing session. These documentation pages themselves require a SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN session and, in production, API_DOCS_ENABLED=true.
